source_exposure: All GP15 values already exposed. These deterministic SI displays and review QC summaries are post-exposure descriptive work; no new validation, causal estimate, fitting, corrected prediction, eligibility rule, weight, or primary score is introduced.

artifact_definitions.selection: Exactly the original twelve variant=primary rows; copy stored numeric tokens. Per-leg Markdown uses seven columns: layer, bottle/station n, observed/model/reference pH, both signed errors.
checks: All six bins per leg, original primary 24/55 unique sample IDs
Stored prediction-minus-observation errors, source counts and IDs; no replacement scoring

artifact_definitions.selection: Existing common-layer memberships only; stations 16/18 on Leg1,31/33 on Leg2. Join by leg+sample ID to existing event identities, export station-by-layer event sets and original raw row locators.
checks: Every common sample belongs to original primary support
Event IDs are metadata; changing events do not create new scores or independent replicates

artifact_definitions.selection: Copy twelve existing weighting=record rows; mean_A, s_of_mean_composition and mean_alpha, preserving original numeric tokens in CSV.
checks: Exact membership sets and counts agree with original primary layers
Markdown rescales A/alpha by 1e8 solely for display
Explicit different geographical support by leg/layer and post-exposure algebraic-description limitations

artifact_definitions.selection: Copy Sm/Gd/Dy/Er PAAS ug/g and original mass mg/mol; convert mass to g/mol by exact Decimal multiplication by .001.
checks: No substitution of modern atomic-weight values; no model response computation

artifact_definitions.selection: Within each complete original pH table, count finite SD1 bottle and fish values separately, as well as rows with any finite SD. Include zero/negative counts and all finite record tokens/IDs/physical CSV line ranges. Intersect source sample IDs with the unique original primary support (24/55) and give exact IDs by leg and overall.
checks: Each primary raw pH source line matches original sample_predictions ph_line
All-source finite counts do not apply flags, depths, eligible pH, or prediction exclusions
No SD imputation or conversion to replicate counts; no claim that finite SD proves accuracy or specifies complete uncertainty

artifact_definitions.selection: From the existing nonzero conflict table retain eligible_primary=True only; preserve raw source IDs/lines and source hash fields. Give requested cumulative 0<abs<=2,0<abs<=10,abs>10 m counts and explicitly separate mutually exclusive 0<abs<=2,2<abs<=10,abs>10 m counts.
checks: Known source 53 nonzero conflicts within 79 unique primary bottles
Every conflict identity/raw row locator agrees with the original table
No zero-difference invention, physical-depth adjudication, exclusion, or reassignment

execution_contract.root_action_before_execution: Independently inspect this script and input/operation scope. Root may freeze a new copy/in-place approved plan by setting frozen=true,frozen_by=root,frozen_at_utc and status=ROOT_FROZEN; preserve actual approved code/input SHA values. The exporter has not been run by its author.
refusal_rules: Wrong runtime, unfrozen/non-root plan, changed code, input role/path/SHA mismatch
Unexpected source rows, IDs, memberships, counts or algebraic consistency failure
Existing output directory, output outside new iteration analysis child, or output path differing from approved plan
Any changed source/script/plan bytes immediately before first output write
execution_contract.write_rule: Construct artifacts in memory, then create a new output directory exclusively; write sources only read-only. A partial failed output is retained and never overwritten.
execution_contract.manifests: source_manifest records plan/script/input identities and field/selection definitions. output_manifest hashes every other output including source_manifest; its own SHA is explicitly omitted to avoid recursive hashing.

author_checks_performed_before_root_revi: Read relevant source CSV headers and first stored diagnostic records; confirmed intended field names.
Wrote new script and this draft plan only.
Computed SHA-256 for exact source/script bytes.
Did not execute/import the exporter, run check-only, calculate its requested new summaries, or create its output directory.
root_review: Read the complete exporter and draft definitions. Approved only exact9boundinput files, existing12primary/12common/12shape rows, unitdisplay, sourceSDavailability and nonzero-depth distribution. No fit, selection, new response evaluation, network or original writes. All outputs remain post-exposure descriptive/QC; reviewed quantities already exposed in cycle01.
